title: 梅里安金礦
subcategoryTitleEn: Gold mines and deep underground systems
summary: 以蘇利南熱帶露天金礦為例，研究降雨、水分、運搬與土地復育。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A tropical Surinamese open-pit gold case examines rainfall, moisture, hauling and land rehabilitation. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 高降雨情境下的集水體積；濕礦供料與乾基產量的差別；雨季循環時間延長的產能敏感度
v31FocusEn: Catchment volumes in a high-rainfall scenario; Wet feed versus dry-basis production; Capacity sensitivity to longer wet-season cycles

steps.title: 高降雨情境下的集水體積：機制與資源流程

steps.objective: 說明「高降雨情境下的集水體積」如何決定「梅里安金礦」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment volumes in a high-rainfall scenario” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Merian gold mine”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「梅里安金礦」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「高降雨情境下的集水體積」。集水面積以公頃、雨量以毫米時，乘以十可得到立方公尺，再以逕流係數估計事件逕流體積。這不是洪峰流量公式，不能直接決定排水渠尺寸；需另處理降雨歷線、入滲、滯洪與流路。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Merian gold mine as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses catchment volumes in a high-rainfall scenario. With area in hectares and rainfall in millimetres, multiplying by ten gives cubic metres; a runoff coefficient estimates event volume. This is not a peak-flow formula and cannot size a channel without storm timing, infiltration, storage and routing. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Catchment volumes in a high-rainfall scenario” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V = A·P·c·10；代入 A = 80 ha、P = 45 mm/event、c = 0.6 runoff fraction，得 21,600 m³/event（集水面積與雨量體積的合成教學算例；輸入單位：A: ha; P: mm/event; c: runoff fraction。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 P 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V = A·P·c·10; with A = 80 ha, P = 45 mm/event, c = 0.6 runoff fraction the result is 21,600 m³/event (synthetic teaching example for catchment rainfall volume; input units: A: ha; P: mm/event; c: runoff fraction. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise P by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 21,600 m³/event（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 P 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 證據版本
knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
